mapper.insert: INSERT INTO common.inquiry_reply_mst ( inquiry_id, reply_no, admin_account_no, created_by, created_at, body ) VALUES ( #{inquiryId}, #{replyNo}, #{adminAccountNo}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), #{body} )
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(reply_no) AS replyNo FROM common.inquiry_reply_mst WHERE inquiry_id = #{inquiryId}
SELECT id, inquiry_id, reply_no, admin_account_no, created_by, created_at, body FROM common.inquiry_reply_mst WHERE inquiry_id = #{inquiryId} ORDER BY reply_no ASC
